projects.name: scx adaptive: Adaptive CPU Scheduler
description: Built an adaptive, multi-policy CPU scheduler on eBPF with FCFS, Round-Robin, and static Priority.

Wrote a user-space controller that reads BPF map telemetry (CPU utilization, burst length, queue latency) and classifies workloads as CPU-bound, interactive, batch, or stress using exponential moving averages.
Added hysteresis-gated policy switching to prevent thrashing on short spikes, plus SIGINT/SIGTERM handling that detaches cleanly and returns control to the default kernel scheduler.

Benchmarked with schbench: adaptive mode cut p99 wakeup latency by 55% (31 µs vs 69 µs) and p99 request latency by 22% (12.6 ms vs 16.3 ms) compared with FCFS, with 1.5% to 1.8% higher throughput than all three fixed policies.

projects.name: eBPF XDP and TC Firewall
description: Built a kernel-space packet filter using XDP to drop traffic at the driver level, before SKB allocation.
Implemented CIDR subnet blacklisting with a BPF LPM trie map and a CLI to block, unblock, and list networks at runtime.
Added DDoS mitigation with per-source-IP TCP SYN and UDP rate limiting using atomic counters.
Built stateful connection tracking with TC ingress and egress hooks, a 5-tuple connection map, and automatic UDP session timeouts.
Added hot configuration reloading from INI files, so thresholds and blocked protocols update without detaching the programs.

projects.name: ext2 File System Reader and Editor
description: Built a CLI tool that parses a raw ext2 disk image, reading the superblock and block group descriptors and printing a dumpe2fs-style summary.
Implemented ls, cd, and cat by walking directory entries and inodes, including files that span multiple blocks.
Added file write support that updates data blocks on the disk image.
